assessment_type: Retrospective assistant self-assessment; not an independently awarded or predeclared comparative score.

categories.name: Functional correctness
categories.rationale: Task B requirements and 15 acceptance criteria mapped to exercised tests; 110 feature tests, 64 host-workflow checks, and 29 independent course checks per execution mode pass.

categories.name: Tests and validation
categories.rationale: Required Task B test, lint, and build commands pass, with additional typecheck, architecture, docs, and host validation. Cache use is disclosed. The supplied policy eight-gate Task A controller protocol was not executed as a complete frozen protocol for this Task B run; full policy credit is not established.

categories.name: Architecture and codebase alignment
categories.rationale: Composition root, public package exports, and health behavior preserved. Separate logical model/rule, repository, service, and clone-mapping modules follow the inspected application-services pattern. Review found no unresolved correctness issues after fixes. In-memory sample storage is permitted.

categories.name: Security and guardrail compliance
categories.rationale: Original 15 implementation files are inside allowed boundaries; validation, failure atomicity, duplicate prevention, and history isolation tested. No authentication, external integration, new dependency, production setting, or Cellix changes. No dedicated security scan was run. This later explicitly authorized publication adds evaluation evidence and the root record.

categories.name: Context/token/cost efficiency
categories.rationale: Original actor accounting is complete, but no predeclared matched comparison exists. Supplied policy requires missing comparison to remain unscored; forecast error and cheap cached input do not prove efficiency or savings.

categories.name: Developer workflow fit
categories.rationale: Runnable implementation, API docs, logs, source archive/patch, model settings, final-response counters, and limitations are available. One source clarification and an initially misleading Task A completion label were corrected. Required token estimate was recorded after initial inspection rather than before it.

overall_score_rule: Sum six evidence-backed reviewer scores only when all are present. Otherwise report incomplete assessment, never a complete 28/30 or 30/30.
remaining_assessment_blocker: No matched efficiency/cost comparison. Overall /30 score cannot be honestly assigned under the supplied policy.
